artifacts.title: Transit fragment
artifacts.content:
I knew the door by heart
Before I knew my name
Table set in the dusk
Jar sealed, holding flame

Blue in the hallway
Roses in the stone

Come through here
It holds, it holds
Come through here
The floor knows
022100
Underfoot, I go

artifacts.title: The route becomes operational
artifacts.content: The house is not a diagram but a route. Blue remains in the hallway and roses remain set into stone. The invitation is operational: “Come through here.” The floor remembers the traveler, and 022100 becomes a coordinate underfoot rather than a symbol overhead.
